description: Query event log entries from an Interoperability production. Returns entries from Ens_Util.Log with timestamp, type, item name, and message text. Filter by log type (Info/Warning/Error/Trace/Assert/Alert), config item name, and maximum row count. Under the block PHI data policy (IRIS_DATA_POLICY) each entry's text is withheld with a reason in textPolicy; under redact and allow it is shown unchanged.

count.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: 100, max: 10000)

itemName.description: Filter by config item name (exact match)

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_production_logs
title: Production Logs
